notes: Fix: Rift Gates no longer pile up around your base. At most one gate can be near you at a time, gates spawn at least 160 blocks apart and never within 64 blocks of world spawn or your bed, you get a 20 minute break after one opens near you, and there are at most 3 in the world. Gates already clustered in your world are thinned out automatically when the world loads, and /scriptevent hollowdeep:cleargates removes them all. Fix: Hexcasters no longer hit you through walls. Their curse bolt now needs a clear line of sight, so ducking behind a wall, floor or closed door protects you, and a Hexcaster that can't see you waits for a shot instead. Fix: Ward Crystals no longer get stuck inside lanterns. The crystal now floats lower under lanterns and low ceilings instead of clipping into them, is removed when its Warded Husk dies, and any crystal left behind (including ones already stuck in your world) is cleared automatically. Leftover rift mobs are also removed when a rift is cleaned up after a restart. Depth update. Chambers now roll objectives (Hold the Sigil, Hunt the Champion, Rune Lock) and can hide optional Reliquaries and Shrines with risky pacts. Bosses raise wards you break by shattering Ward Anchors, and each arena has its own hazard. Tier V bosses are Ascended, with a Last Stand phase and a chance at one of four new unique relics. New Hollow Forge to ascend, temper, reroll and salvage relics, and ten Delver ranks with permanent perks. Fixes: dying in a rift reliably gives a Soul Tether once you're alive again (it relied on the respawn event, and was lost with a full inventory); Rift Gates now actually appear (they needed perfectly flat ground, so outside plains they almost never spawned; now they try 12 spots per attempt and accept ground one block up or down), and /scriptevent hollowdeep:gate opens one near you. Bosses no longer start a fight already in phase 2.
